neighbours.label: Manhattan-style street addresses with a numbered street ('534 West 25th Street', 'East 86th Street'), firing on the street number after West/East; addresses without a numbered street stay quiet.
fire: The gallery moved to 520 West 21st Street.

The museum sits at 1 East 70th Street.
